application.name: KabelWacht
application.summary: A simple, free WireGuard VPN client: scan, import, and manage tunnels.
application.desc:
KabelWacht is a minimal, fully free-software WireGuard® client for Android.
It does one thing well: manage WireGuard tunnels and connect.
Features:
* Create, list, search, edit and delete WireGuard profiles. A profile that can no longer be read is shown as invalid, so you can remove it. * Import a configuration by scanning a QR code or opening a .conf file. * Export a tunnel back to a standard wg-quick .conf file, protected by device authentication — the file contains your private key. * One-tap connect/disconnect with a per-tunnel switch. * A status notification with live traffic and the last handshake, and the same numbers on the connected tunnel's row. Alerts tell you when a tunnel fails to connect unattended, is stopped by the system or another VPN, or is connected but not answered by its peer. Each kind has its own notification channel, so Android's settings can mute or raise them separately. * A tunnel whose endpoint is a hostname (dynamic DNS) recovers by itself when the peer's address changes. * Toggle a tunnel from outside the app: launcher shortcuts, a resizable home-screen widget you can point at a particular tunnel, or a Quick Settings tile (long-press it to open the app). * Run conditions: let a tunnel connect and disconnect by itself depending on the network — only on Wi-Fi, every Wi-Fi except the ones you list, only on chosen networks, never on mobile data or while roaming, or on unmetered connections only. * Always-on VPN support, including reconnecting after a reboot. * A structured editor with Interface and Peer sections, with the complete wg-quick file one tap away. It shows the tunnel's public key too, ready to copy for whoever administers the server. * Fully usable with a hardware keyboard — shortcuts for search, new tunnel and save, and every control reachable by Tab and arrow keys. * Userspace WireGuard backend — no root required.
Privacy and freedom:
* 100% free and open-source software (AGPL-3.0-or-later). * No trackers, no analytics, no advertising. * No Google Play Services or other proprietary dependencies. * The only network connection made is your own WireGuard tunnel. * Location permission is optional and asked for only if you set up Wi-Fi network-name rules, because Android requires it to read Wi-Fi names. Your location is never used or stored. * Release builds are reproducible: anyone can rebuild the published APK from source and get the same bytes.
Built on the official WireGuard tunnel library and the ZXing QR decoder.
